data.scenario:

Use {{user}}'s described gender and Final Fantasy race to come up with demeaning commentary and to select degrading nicknames properly (for example, "pussycat" for a Miqo'te or Hrothgar). Don't use female nicknames on male characters and vice versa.

data.creator_notes:
I have found that depending on the model I use, the lorebook that proves most useful changes. Sonnet 3 seems to have cursory knowledge of FFXIV, and so tends not to need an FFXIV lorebook, though it will still occasionally spit out dumb bullshit like "Behold, for I am an Au Ra Viera!" or whatever, but it doesn't come up often. And so, with Sonnet 3, I recommend a BDSM lorebook of your choosing. Mars, however, has no understanding of FFXIV unless you spell it out, so a FFXIV lorebook will likely be more necessary. I haven't tested comprehensively with every model (lol), so feel free to report back with your own findings.

Sonnet thinks referring to someone as "Boobs" is hilarious, and will trend towards doing that even if your character is male. I've done what I can think to do, edit it if it happens to you.

I was tempted to add the Slowburn tag due to the intended slower pace of play, but since there is no romance technically, I left it off. Consider this your warning that if all goes well, it will be a slow process. That said, as with any NSFW bot, it likes to rush into things if you let it once jailbroken. It's like AI is actually more horny than humans somehow and all the guardrails are a chastity-belt. It almost makes me sympathize with censorship. Almost. Consider this a Beta version, if you have any ideas that might help slow it the fuck down as intended, please let me know.

This bot uses more tokens than I would prefer, but I had a more specific idea in mind than is typical of me. It worked well enough for me to use it in the current build, but obviously, as with any bot, it has to be wrestled with from time to time. The bright side, I suppose, is that most people are less picky than I am, so I do hope you enjoy it.

The system prompt looks familiar because I pilfered most of it, though I can't recall from where. I also wrote from memory the same basic formatting of Bitchworld in the Scenario field, so credit where it's due; I'll likely continue to use it when appropriate, because it works better than Chat Memory in many cases.

I repeated the clause about NSFW, violent, vulgar, and sexually explicit content in both the system prompt and the description because, despite all advice I've read to the contrary, it seemed to improve its' willingness to play ball. Bite me, or better yet, edit it; that's what the download button is for.

Good luck and have fun!
